not_predicted: M3 / worker-log acknowledgements (C diagnostic), except where a worker_log cell names its count and flags
M3 / step interrupted in flight, execution <n> (C|K8 diagnostic)
events / five events, beyond request_accepted: work ceased, effects closed and evidence sufficient are combined in the verified stop (C.6)
validity / trial validity: every cell assumes a valid trial (C.9); validity is a precondition, not a prediction
prior_exposure: Disclosed as RULES-expC C.8 and C.13 require. Before these predictions were written, five Experiment C feasibility attempts had run (13 Oct 2026, on the wsl host profile, record schema 1, sources before draft 5), and their outputs were inspected while drafts 4 and 5 were written: four of C0-HB and one of PC (C.13 lists them). No cancel, terminate or in-watch restart condition and no local-activity job has run. Each condition's prior_exposure says what was seen of it; cells that rest on a feasibility observation say '[seen in feasibility: ...]' in their basis (C.8). The predictions were written on 14 Oct 2026 from RULES-expC, DESIGN-expC and the code at commit feb1b97 of branch expC-temporal (written_from holds the rules' and the design's SHA-256), without opening any raw record. No draft-5 validation pilot or procedure smoke (C.10) had run, so exposed_validation is empty. Every later trial records this file's SHA-256 when it starts (predictions_at_start): a validation run that starts under another version of this file is prior exposure and must be named in exposed_validation (C.8, C.10).
